extension: Initialization measured by actual normalized native neighbor action, then ordinary mean-own full-task CE
representative_task: Authentic complete Tolokers official split0, original benchmark exploratory comparison; TEST truth unopened
prerequisites: Root completes the ordinary native competence screen; this packet inspects no scores or running outcomes
Freeze one competent native preset/optimizer contract by the predeclared original-input full-VALID selection rule
Qualify geometry-only incidence ownership, fresh construction/restoration and identity-factor equivalence before science
Qualify actual normalized sparse operator/pre-ELU value capture and off-node action extraction; never use detached unnormalized .L
Qualify exact row-sign invariance and zero-right-value ignored-action failure as implementation checks; no duplicate science fits
Retain competent native single, ordinary shared bank and genuine independent references

fixed.warmup: Same shared native theta with all incidence factors fixed at identity, four stochastic full-input paths/epoch, mean own NLL; identical restored warmup model/optimizer/RNG branches for paired arms
fixed.postinitialization: Learn theta and geometry-only private incidence factors by ordinary mean-own full-TRAIN NLL only; no auxiliary diversity/context loss
fixed.optimizer: Frozen native ordinary Adam/lr/decay rules, no new grid
fixed.selection: Original-input full VALID pooled AUROC only, saved selected state and fresh reconstruction; no initializer or source diagnostic selected using VALID
fixed.serving: Four full native paths on complete original input, mean native probabilities, same shared head/stem/feature transforms

initializer.scope: Input fast factors of first ordered incidence learner only; output factors and later-layer factors start at identity
initializer.direction_rule: Seeded Rademacher input-factor directions, normalized to unit L2, fixed before trial scores; use both plus/minus signs for each direction
initializer.trial_mode: Native eval, dropout off, zero eval jitter, forward only, exact same full input and common theta; no author code import/execution in preparation
initializer.trial_paths: One baseline plus sixteen complete native trial forwards; all three shared initialization arms compute the same trials and diagnostics
initializer.finite_gate: Finite native operators/states/probabilities/NLL; retained failed trials
initializer.local_nll_gate: Both signs satisfy TRAIN NLL <= baseline NLL + 0.001*max(baseline NLL,0.01); local screening budget only, no generalization/safety theorem
initializer.value_visibility_gate: Both normalized off-node action changes have nonzero relative norm above 1e-6, using denominator max(norm(baseline off-node action),1)
initializer.classifier_visibility_gate: Both full TRAIN binary-margin changes have relative norm above 1e-6, using denominator max(norm(baseline margin vector),1)
initializer.action_vector: Vectorized (L_trial,off-L_baseline,off) V_star from the common actual first-layer transformed state; preserve native augmentation/SVD/clamp and all off-node dimensions
initializer.action_pair_score: Let a_j be normalized action vector for direction j computed as half the plus-minus action difference. Choose two qualified directions maximizing 1-(a_j dot a_k)^2, hashed ties; require the pair difference vectors nonzero by the same relative floor
initializer.member_values: The selected two plus/minus pairs give four member first-input factors 1+/-0.01*u_j, with all other factors initially identity
initializer.failure: Fewer than two admissible nonzero pairs, or no classifier-visible action, retains an unqualified initializer; no reseeding/dose/search expansion
initializer.scope_limit: Parameter pairing is not exact prediction averaging; no continuous gauge projection or later-training guarantee
initializer.invariance_scope: The statistic is unchanged by edge-stalk transformations that leave deployed L identical, including exact native row signs. It compares actions in the actual common value coordinates; it is not an independently framed node-gauge quotient. Retrained frame controls remain required.

minimal_paired_arms.selection: First two qualified direction pairs by a prospective independent hash order, same trials/step/gates/parameter norms/initial label opportunity

Same pair-score formula using full TRAIN class-margin plus-minus differences instead of action vectors, same candidates/trials/step/gates; generic functional-screen comparator, not called native FoRDE

ordinary_reference: Identity-initialized shared geometry-only bank, same warmup/full-task continuation and reconstruction; cheaper trial work explicit
removed_redundant_fits: Output-row-sign gauge clones: exact same native real-arithmetic evaluation function, use qualification only
Categorical member enumeration with same conditional trajectories/objective: representation of same finite bank
Joint presentation with exact same fixed mean-softmax branches/readout/objective: same predictor, not a rival training arm

source_response_assay.patches: V2's prospectively fixed label/feature-blind four graph patches; sources are each patch intersect TRAIN, no query selection
source_response_assay.variants: For each patch, zero only its TRAIN feature rows; leave all VALID query own rows and all other rows fixed, retain support and recompute actual native paths
source_response_assay.query_population: Every VALID row, after original-input checkpoint selection/restoration
source_response_assay.graph_paths: Four original plus sixteen patch-ablation member forwards, sixteen extra if original predictions already retained
source_response_assay.responses: Per-member/source class margins, probabilities, CE gain from source presence, magnitude/shape and whether scalar rescaling explains differences
source_response_assay.additional_correspondence_gate: Predeclared within-patch source feature-identity permutation if useful source correspondence is credited; charge its complete paths
source_response_assay.qualification: Input ablations are observational and not proven label preserving; all source-response results are exploratory since VALID already selects models

decision_rules: Require useful restored full-input pooled AUROC and fixed-argmax accuracy/NLL/Brier, with every member's quality and mean/worst/best reported
Strong individual paths must satisfy the prospectively frozen ordinary competence rule; no pooled claim may hide failed members
Require benefit over random admissible and classifier-response-screened initialization before crediting the live-action selection statistic
Initializer screening scores, action Gram changes or source-response rank without pooled utility do not support useful diversity
No selected checkpoint after initializer activation means no initialization effect was tested
A scalar action-amplitude change or classifier/source invisibility rejects the stated functional specialization attribution
Charge all warmup, qualification, seventeen trial paths, training/backwards, selection/reconstruction and source assays; no parameter-count efficiency claim
Mixed paired-seed pattern is inconclusive; no protocol repair or additional initializer sweep from outcomes
broader_attribution_controls: Competent original BSNN with faithful sampling/ELBO/KL and four full serving draws; declare general versus Cayley operator-family differences

Proper global Rank-1 Bayesian incidence-factor or structured-latent state-conditioned generator, with native factor priors/KL and sampling preserved or explicit adaptations; one global factor draw reused across all incidences, four full serving draws
Genuine complete independent native ensemble with own heads/optimizers/selected checkpoints and the same initializer opportunity; charge all paths
Parameter-matched pointwise/private-feature or flat/node-frame replacement with common head, plus simple signed-message bank grounded in FAGCN; retrain and qualify competence
Capable joint multi-transport model with declared fused readout/objective/capacity, rather than a weak linear LMGC proxy or an algebraically identical fixed-pool relabeling
